Content: A `0.50` `text(kg)` object is attached to a vertical spring of constant `k`, as shown above. The object is pulled down and released. The object oscillates vertically. If up is the positive direction, the position `x` of the object as a function of time `t` is given by the formula `x=betasin(omegat+varphi)`, where `beta=0.20` `text(m)`, `omega=4.0` `text(rad)//text(s)`, and `varphi=pi//3` `text(rad)`.
